commit.subject: LU-6142 llapi: make llapi_uuid_match() arguments const
commit.message:
LU-6142 llapi: make llapi_uuid_match() arguments const

llapi_uuid_match() only reads its two strings. Mark them const,
so callers can pass a const string without a cast.

This does not change the ABI. Existing callers still build.

Test-Parameters: trivial
Signed-off-by: Hiroshi Nishida <hnishida@thelustrecollective.com>
Change-Id: I5d3b088ed48fb22051854ff0f5ca2530f564909d
